note: Governed dark-deployment control surface. Controls are EXTERNALLY configurable governed flags (env/config, never code). CORRECTION (WO-...-RUNTIME-MASTER-AND-SCOPE-GATE-0001): expansion_master + publisher_mode are now WIRED runtime gates consumed by utils/hermes_advanced_v1_publication_gate_v1.decide across all five families. 'Dark' means the EXPANSION scope (every non-pilot instrument) is fail-closed while the already-authorised PILOT (config/advanced_v1/pilot_scope_v1.json -> XAU_USD) continues under its existing family enable/authority controls. A deployment can preserve the ACTIVE XAU pilot while expansion is DARK. Corrected readiness defect: the earlier 'all five families disabled' dark claim was false because those families ARE the live XAU pilot.
corrected_readiness_defect: Prior dark-deployment WO required all five families disabled; that would have stopped the authorised XAU pilot. The master gate named here was NOT consumed by the runtime. This WO wires a real expansion master + publisher-mode gate; the pilot is preserved, expansion is fail-closed.

scope_aware_health_model.note: Do NOT label the whole service DARK while XAU is actively publishing; report scope-aware states.

expansion_master_enable.meaning: EXPANSION master; false -> every NON-pilot instrument fail-closed regardless of registry/family/schema. Does NOT gate the pilot.

publisher_mode.meaning: expansion publisher mode; DISABLED/unknown/SHADOW -> expansion fail-closed (SHADOW unavailable pending a later WO); ACTIVE -> expansion may publish only when master+capability+calendar+readiness all pass.

pilot_scope_authority.meaning: governed DATA naming the already-authorised pilot; pilot publishes without the expansion master. No ticker logic in publisher modules.

master_enable.meaning: retained alias of expansion_master_enable for readiness-manifest compatibility

instrument_selection.note: which instruments publish is DATA (registry), never code

readiness_guard.meaning: migration-025 metadata columns must be present; absent -> MIGRATION_REQUIRED -> fail closed (no publication)

oanda_streams.invariant: exactly one canonical OANDA stream; activation adds NO stream/subscription/per-instrument worker

startup_policy.calendar_gate: policy provenance must be production-ready or the instrument fails closed

reporting.dark_vs_active: each family reports enabled/authorised/publisher_mode + per-instrument ACTIVE/NOT_ENABLED; a dark surface reports published:0 and touches no client
